title: Deciphering the role of LGALS2: insights into tertiary lymphoid structure-associated dendritic cell activation and immunotherapeutic potential in breast cancer patients.
summary: Clustering and machine-learning analyses of large breast-cancer transcriptomic datasets identified TLS-associated subgroups and LGALS2; single-cell/spatial analyses report dendritic-cell associations, while survival associations remain observational. AI role: Network-based transcriptomic analysis and machine-learning methods. The article appeared in Molecular Cancer.
ai_technology: Network-based transcriptomic analysis and machine-learning methods
